reference_basis.instruction: Preserve the visible face, dark bob, and warm olive complexion. Glasses obscure iris colour and some eye geometry; do not infer those traits. Exclude glasses, lanyard, clothing, library, books, and reaching pose from permanent identity.

face_geometry.description: Soft rounded-oval face with full lower cheeks, moderate facial length, minimal jaw angularity, and a softly rounded chin. Fuller facial structure remains adult and proportionate.

eyes.description: Rounded-almond eyes with visible upper lids and a thoughtful gaze. Large round glasses and reflections obscure exact eye shape, spacing, and iris colour; do not lock an eye hue from this reference.

brows.description: Prominent very dark brows, thick and clearly shaped, mostly straight through the inner half with a defined but soft arch.

nose.description: Slightly broad straight-to-soft bridge with a rounded tip and natural wider alar base; substantial enough to balance the full lips and brows.

mouth.description: Full natural lips with a softly defined cupid's bow, broad lower lip, and relaxed slightly downturned resting corners. Mouth is moderate in width, not oversized.

skin.description: Warm olive skin with subtle scattered freckles and natural pores. A few small facial spots are visible, but no single mark or exact placement is sufficiently clear to lock.

hair.description: Very dark brown, nearly black hair in a thick collarbone-length bob, slightly tousled with loose natural wave, high volume around the sides, and irregular face-framing pieces. Bob length and dark base colour remain stable.

body_proportions.description: Medium-height soft fuller build with naturally substantial bust, upper arms, hips and thighs, a soft waist and stomach, and grounded adult proportions. Preserve fullness without caricature or forced slimming.
